cases.the second command hook of an event, in: <BASE>/Agent/.claude/settings.json runs the Stop hook (number 2), which is not the kit's own; move it to your user settings (~/.claude/settings.json), then start again
cases.a command hook after a prompt hook is nu: <BASE>/Agent/.claude/settings.json runs the Stop hook (number 2), which is not the kit's own; move it to your user settings (~/.claude/settings.json), then start again
cases.a project apiKeyHelper is not the kit's: <BASE>/Agent/.claude/settings.json runs apiKeyHelper, which is not the kit's own; move it to your user settings (~/.claude/settings.json), then start again
